brief:
Settlers carried out an attack southwest of Jenin in the northern West Bank, injuring three Palestinians, including a child, the Shehab Wire reported. The assault took place in an area south and west of the city.

No immediate details emerged regarding the specific circumstances of the attack, the identities of those wounded, or their current medical condition. Settler violence against Palestinians in the West Bank has intensified in recent months, with multiple incidents reported across various locations in the territory.
